description:
Get one run by id — full status, output text, asset URLs,
caption, and any error. Poll this after create_campaign
or render_asset until status is terminal. Wait `poll_after_seconds`
between polls; `progress` and `eta_seconds` say how far along it is.
A finished film carries `film_check`, advice only: when `ok` is
false, show the human the video and the findings and let them decide.
Re-render at most once, and only for a defect you can name in what you
sent (a missing image, a wrong name). `notices` are plain-words notes
on the request (e.g. it asked for a mood the brand's look does not
wear): the asset is made as asked; pass the note to the human. A
finished run carries `caption`: the post caption Siren wrote in the
run's brand (or yours, if you passed one); show it with the asset. After
post_run, `posts[]` carries each platform's status and, once it
fires, the live URL and the caption that went out.

run_id.description: The run id returned by create_campaign, render_asset, or list_runs.

name: get_run
